target.title: feat(qwen): add Token Plan (Team Edition) provider
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

OpenClaw supports Qwen Standard, Coding Plan, and OAuth, but not Alibaba Cloud Token Plan (Team Edition) as a first-class provider. Token Plan users currently need a large manual provider definition, and Alibaba's documented `bailian-token-plan` example must remain an exact custom-provider contract rather than becoming a canonical catalog alias.

Closes #94418.

## Why This Change Was Made

This adds canonical `qwen-token-plan` support with:

- Global/Singapore and China/Beijing onboarding choices and dedicated endpoints.
- The current exact 14-model Token Plan chat catalog.
- Model-specific thinking behavior for Qwen, DeepSeek, Kimi, GLM, and MiniMax, including replay and tool-call wire constraints.
- Native streaming-usage compatibility and isolated `QWEN_TOKEN_PLAN_API_KEY` handling.
- Independent runtime compatibility for Alibaba's documented `bailian-token-plan` custom-provider ID.

`bailian-token-plan` intentionally has runtime hooks only—no built-in auth, discovery catalog, static catalog, or environment variables—so existing custom transport, credentials, model rows, and explicit thinking formats remain authoritative.

Config-risk metric: +2 provider IDs, +2 auth choices, +1 environment variable, +2 native endpoints, and +14 catalog rows. All additions are additive; no existing provider ID or config shape changes.

## User Impact

Users can onboard with `qwen-token-plan` or `qwen-token-plan-cn`, authenticate with a region-matched Token Plan key, and select models such as `qwen-token-plan/qwen3.7-plus`. Existing `bailian-token-plan/*` configurations continue using their explicitly configured transport and catalog.

Token Plan is documented for interactive coding and agent use. The provider docs warn against cron, unattended batch, and application-backend use that can violate the subscription terms.

## Evidence

- Testbox `tbx_01kx3r67gg3788ydbktswk1x2d` — [Actions run 29029979874](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29029979874): extension production/test types passed; 62 stream behavior tests passed.
- Testbox `tbx_01kx3rrnapm9etmm41yw1sq5ds` — [Actions run 29030650617](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29030650617): 93 Qwen plugin tests passed after rebasing onto current `main`.
- Testbox `tbx_01kx3s68spj9h41yfeqwxpxnw2d` — [Actions run 29031140942](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29031140942): the complete docs gate passed after regenerating `docs/docs_map.md`, including markdown lint, MDX validation, 0 broken links, and the generated-map check.
- Exact-head [hosted CI run 29044964642](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29044964642) passed at `41d3aba1660bedfddd64cddad931c99503d9dd55`: 70 successful checks, 27 skipped, 1 neutral, no failures.
- Plugin inventory generation check, targeted extension lint/format, JSON parsing, and `git diff --check` passed.
- Direct AWS Crabbox `cbx_cac8973735b8` used a fresh public-network lease with no Tailscale or instance role. Every untrusted run fetched PR #94419, verified exact head `41d3aba1660bedfddd64cddad931c99503d9dd55`, and injected only `QWEN_TOKEN_PLAN_API_KEY` without printing it.
- Packaged install proof (`run_42ddb175423c`, corrected catalog projection `run_6e37435ce5bb`): built and integrity-checked the OpenClaw tarball, installed it into an empty prefix, installed packed `@openclaw/qwen-provider` through `npm-pack:`, onboarded Global Token Plan with an environment-backed ref, and loaded the plugin as a trusted official install. Gateway start/restart health passed in `run_3de82699f9b6`.
- The packaged catalog exposed exactly the 14 current chat rows and excluded image-generation-only `qwen-image-2.0` and `wan2.7-image`, matching Alibaba's [current exact allowlist](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/token-plan-overview) after excluding its four dedicated image-generation rows.
- Global OpenAI-compatible live turns all returned HTTP 200 through Alibaba's [documented Singapore endpoint](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/token-plan-quickstart): `qwen3.7-plus` text (`run_d4adc29225fa`), one-call read tool (`run_6fe6dad65c19`), and generated color-marker vision (`run_ac2e7ab2bd37`); thinking-off `kimi-k2.7-code` (`run_7f9917a79372`) and `MiniMax-M2.5` (`run_aba73f8599bf`); `deepseek-v4-pro` max/tool then off/replay in one session (`run_be02dfa638e0`, `run_d7ad1299c6e6`); `glm-5.2` max/tool (`run_6a881cdac00a`); and advertised `deepseek-v3.2` availability (`run_703b790ca40c`).
- Exact manual `bailian-token-plan` retained its one-row custom catalog and `anthropic-messages` transport, then completed a real HTTP 200 `/v1/messages` turn (`run_68519df9b5d0`).
- China onboarding wrote the documented Beijing endpoint and 14-row catalog (`run_ec81d94f1c3c`). A China live turn was intentionally not attempted because no separately scoped China key was available; the Global key was not reused cross-region.
- Invalid Global auth reached the exact endpoint, failed as authentication, exited 1, and did not echo the placeholder credential (`run_9da2493884b2`).
- Source-blind behavior validation: 7/8 tasks pass; no failed or inconclusive clause. The sole blocked subtask is the conditional China live/cross-region proof requiring a separate China key.
- Fresh whole-diff Codex autoreview (GPT-5.6) found no accepted or actionable findings; overall verdict: patch correct (0.91 confidence).

The implementation preserves contributor credit with `Co-authored-by: Oliver Mee <102673257+Omee11@users.noreply.github.com>`.
